messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'eu-resv-2' 100% GPU util, queue backlog 11,842 (5m growth). Autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (error: quota_exceeded). Affected tenants: SpectralBank, KoiHealth. Severity: P1. Paging @oncall-sre and @eng-runtime. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-pool-exhaustion :rotating_light:
oncall-sre (alice): On it. ACKing page. Starting triage now.
oncall-sre (alice): Quick summary pls: which autoscaler error and which region?
eng-runtime-bot: Autoscaler events (last 15m):
```
E 2026-03-14T21:12:02Z autoscaler: scale_request failed: create_nodes -> error=QuotaExceeded(project="prod-eu", resource="gpus")
W 2026-03-14T21:12:05Z autoscaler: backing-off new attempts for pool eu-resv-2 (quota_exceeded)
I 2026-03-14T21:13:11Z router: queue_growth +5200 reqs (1m)
```
ben: I'm runtime oncall. Confirmed quota_exceeded. Looks like global GPU quota in our EU account hit hard. Provisioning from cloud APIs is failing.
carol: Any noisy tenant signal? Are there long-running sessions hogging KV cache?
ben: Yes. Metrics show 2 tenants with >9h sessions continuously holding GPU contexts. SpectralBank has 120 long sessions pinned, KoiHealth 88. Their tail latency high but throughput steady.
oncall-sre (alice): Immediate mitigation options: 1) Evict idle/older sessions in that pool, 2) Shift some enterprise tenants to fallback routing (other region or lower-cap model), 3) Enable burst from shared pool (if allowed), 4) Emergency quota request (slow). Which we can do fast?
ben: We can evict idle sessions and start smart-routing for a subset. Burst is disabled for this pool by policy but can be toggled by ops. Quota request won't help in next 30m.
ops-bot: run_command: `rctl pool eu-resv-2 list-sessions --filter "idle>30m OR pinned=true" --limit 500`
carol: Running eviction plan now. We'll mark sessions with age>6h as eviction candidates and gracefully terminate. Notify customers before hard kill.
customer-success: I'm drafting an outbound to SpectralBank and KoiHealth: short note explaining degraded throughput, we will reroute a subset of their requests to eu-fallback-1, and asking permission to terminate idle sessions older than 6h in the next 10m. draft: "We’re experiencing capacity pressure in EU reserved GPUs; to restore throughput we’ll reroute traffic and terminate stale sessions. Expect partial service impact for 2-10 minutes." We can post if you approve. :+1:
ben: Approve the customer msg. Start eviction script when ready. Also start routing change for non-critical routes for those tenants. Use policy: `route.priority=fallback,traffic_pct=30` initially.
eng-runtime-bot: Triggering routing change: `route apply --tenant SpectralBank --from eu-resv-2 --to eu-fallback-1 --pct 30`
eng-runtime-bot: Routing change applied for SpectralBank (30%). Now starting for KoiHealth.
oncall-sre (alice): Eviction run starting (graceful termination window 30s). Command: ```
rctl session evict --pool eu-resv-2 --age-gt 6h --grace 30s --notify "Capacity mitigation: terminating stale session"
```
ops-bot: Eviction job summary (started): matched=208, terminated=142, drained=66. ETA queue impact: immediate.
deploy-bot: canary-rollback: canary for feature X rolled back in eu-resv-2 (reason: reduced capacity).
ben: Queue length dropping: 11,842 -> 6,200 in 4m after evictions + 30% reroute. Token generation QPS for tenants improved.
customer-success: Sent customer notifications to SpectralBank + KoiHealth. Both acknowledged and asked for postmortem.
oncall-sre (alice): Next steps: 1) Keep 30% reroute for 10m, monitor queue. 2) Open emergency quota ticket (cloud) and mark as blocking. 3) Follow-up: update runbook to include earlier detection of pinned sessions and add alert for long-session-count>50. 4) Schedule postmortem meeting with customers and Eng within 48h.
ben: Filed cloud quota ticket #CLOUD-47281 (priority P0), ETA unknown. Also created internal ticket INF-9823 to allow controlled burst toggle for enterprise pools.
eng-runtime-bot: Metrics snapshot (post-mitigation): gpu_util=92% -> 68%, queue=6,200 -> 1,400 (30m), avg_latency tokens=210ms -> 160ms.
carol: Good. We'll keep monitoring. Reassigning to evening oncall for watch. If queue trends upward again, plan B is to escalate to region failover and increase reroute pct.
oncall-sre (alice): Closing the active paging state. Marking incident as 'mitigated' but still open until quota resolved and postmortem ticket created.
incident-bot: Incident P1 mitigated by triage/eviction/reroute. See runbook link and tickets: INF-9823, CLOUD-47281.
customer-success: Adding postmortem invite: 2026-03-15 10:00 UTC. Invite sent.
ben: Action items (short): 
- runbook: add detection for long-session pinned resources (owner: eng-platform)
- autoscaler: add better error classification for quota_exceeded to trigger fallback earlier (owner: eng-runtime)
- ops: add burst-toggle flow and SSO guardrails (owner: eng-infra)
carol: Noted. Will create the JIRA and assign.
oncall-sre (alice): Thanks team. Leaving handoff notes to night oncall. If anything spikes, ping this thread. :eyes:
